## Description

What needs to be done and why, in a few sentences. Say what will exist when it is finished (a document, a table, a decision, a passing check).

## Done When

- [ ] A checkable condition, for example "a teammate who did not write it can follow it"
- [ ] Reviewed in a pull request

## Documentation affected

- [ ] File or folder to add or update
- [ ] Decision to record in `docs/decisions/` (if this changes the design)

## Notes

Anything else a reviewer or teammate should know, including related issues. Do not include credentials, tokens, or private data.
